title: Growing Up: Everyone's Timeline Is Different

callouts.label: Growing Has Many Early Signs
callouts.hint: A child ties shoes beside a pair that has become too small.
callouts.description: Growth happens throughout childhood, and outgrown clothes or shoes can be ordinary signs.
callouts.ap_tip: Puberty is one later stage in the long process of growing.

callouts.label: Some Changes Begin Earlier
callouts.hint: One student stands taller among peers in a calm school scene.
callouts.description: Some students notice growth changes earlier than classmates.
callouts.ap_tip: Earlier does not mean better, worse, or more mature.

callouts.label: Some Changes Begin Later
callouts.hint: A shorter student participates confidently with friends.
callouts.description: Other students notice changes later, and that is normal too.
callouts.ap_tip: There is no correct age that fits every body.

callouts.label: Hygiene Needs May Change
callouts.hint: A trusted adult helps a child choose simple skin and hygiene supplies.
callouts.description: Growing bodies may sweat more or need adjusted skin and hygiene routines.
callouts.ap_tip: A trusted adult can help find a routine that fits the student and family.

callouts.label: Feelings Can Feel Stronger
callouts.hint: A child breathes with hands on chest and stomach.
callouts.description: Puberty can bring stronger, mixed, or more sudden emotions.
callouts.ap_tip: All feelings are allowed; safe coping and support help.

callouts.label: Peers Grow at Different Paces
callouts.hint: Friends of varied heights and abilities enjoy one activity together.
callouts.description: Bodies can be at different stages while students share the same interests and belonging.
callouts.ap_tip: Do not tease or compare someone’s body.

callouts.label: Ask at Home
callouts.hint: A child asks a parent or guardian a question in a calm room.
callouts.description: Parents, guardians, and trusted family members can answer questions and listen.
callouts.ap_tip: There are no silly questions about growing.

callouts.label: Ask at School
callouts.hint: A school nurse and counselor sit in a welcoming office.
callouts.description: School nurses, teachers, and counselors can help with questions or feelings during the school day.
callouts.ap_tip: Students can ask for a private conversation.

callouts.label: Ask a Health Professional
callouts.hint: A clinician talks with a child and caregiver.
callouts.description: Doctors and other health professionals can explain body changes and check concerns.
callouts.ap_tip: A student deserves clear, respectful answers.

callouts.label: Every Path Can Be Normal
callouts.hint: Students move forward on several equally bright parallel paths.
callouts.description: Puberty unfolds gradually and at different times for different people.
callouts.ap_tip: Every timeline deserves privacy and respect.
